definitions.explanation: The act of traveling to a destination, especially for pleasure or exploration. Often has a poetic or literary nuance compared to 旅行.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{旅|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: To set out on a long journey.

examples.japanese: {旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{素敵|すてき}→すてき：02356_suteki⟧⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a wonderful place during my travels.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ような→ようだ：26593_youda⟧⟦もの→もの：10988_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: To preserve travel memories in photographs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}{旅|たび}→一人旅：18216_hitoritabi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{寂|さび}しく→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Traveling alone is freeing, but sometimes you get lonely too.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to set out on a journey)
- {旅|たび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to travel)
- {旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧ (travel memories)
- {旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧ (travel fatigue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅|たび}: Journey (poetic, literary, emphasizes the experience)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: Trip, travel (general, practical term)
- ⟦{旅路|たびじ}→旅路：12987_tabiji⟧: Journey, travels (literary)

PROVERB:
- {旅|たび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{掻|か}き→掻く：09647_kaku⟧⟦{捨|す}て→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: What happens on the road stays on the road (One can be less inhibited when traveling)
